content.rendered:
Psiphon pro handler A+ is another popular app, that is simple and easy to use with a neat user interface(ui). It works well on all versions of Android phones.

About 
Millions of people in over 200 countries around the planet are already connecting to the Internet using Psiphon, the most robust circumvention tool on the web.

Psiphon facilitates access to websites and services which are censored, blocked, or otherwise unavailable, no matter where you are in the world. Whether you can’t access your favourite news broadcast today, or want to provide an extra layer of protection when using public Wi-Fi services, Psiphon is the best tool for accessing the open Internet.

Size
4mb

Type
Apk

Requires Android
2.3 and up

Do visit our blog for more updates.
